title: NoBlockInteract
description: NoBlockInteract is a lightweight Paper plugin that prevents players from interacting with blocks, fully configurable per-world, per-gamemode and with multiple filters.
body:
**NoBlockInteract** is a lightweight Paper plugin that prevents players from interacting with blocks, fully configurable per-world, per-gamemode and with multiple filters.

You can choose which interaction actions are blocked (left/right click, physical), define world scope (all/whitelist/blacklist), add material and held-item allow/deny lists, and set bypass permissions. Optional feedback (MiniMessage), actionbar, sounds and cooldowns are included for a clean user experience. Ideal for lobby servers, adventure maps, and protected spawn areas.

**Commands:**

**/noblockinteract reload**
Reloads the config.yml without restarting the server.

**Permissions:**

**noblockinteract.bypass**

Allows players to bypass all interaction restrictions.

**noblockinteract.reload**

Allows reloading the config with /noblockinteract reload (default: OP).
